name: BARE
_comment: The whole language: 11 reserved words (bare_core.tokens.KEYWORDS), 3 literal keywords (LITERAL_KEYWORDS) and 7 builtins (bare_core.builtins.BUILTINS). `input` is a keyword rather than a builtin because the interpreter handles it specially. Matching is case-sensitive — the lexer compares the word as written.

string.comment: Double-quoted. The lexer accepts exactly \n \t \\ and \" (bare_core/lexer.py); anything else after a backslash is not a valid escape.
string.name: string.quoted.double.bare

sub_definition.comment: sub name(args) ... end — BARE's only procedure form, and there is no colon.

keyword_control.comment: if / else / while / end delimit every block; there is no elif and no colon.
keyword_control.name: keyword.control.bare

support_builtin.comment: The seven builtins in BUILTINS. `input` is a keyword, not one of these.
support_builtin.name: support.function.builtin.bare

patterns.comment: Two-character forms first, so == is not read as two = and <= not as < then =.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.comparison.bare

patterns.comment: Indexing a string or list is BARE's one way in — see libraries/string_lib.bare.
patterns.name: punctuation.definition.index.bare
